nodes.label: SCENR MVP Product
nodes.rationale: Turns group-trip scattered media into polished social content in ~2 min; 2-week MVP build scoped to Post/Carousel/Story, deferring Reel and music. North star: every group trip ends with content everyone is proud to post, created in coffee-order time with zero editing skill required.

nodes.label: Backend (Supabase)
nodes.rationale: Collapses aspirational microservice topology into one managed platform. Includes Postgres + pgvector, Auth, Storage, Realtime, Edge Functions. Chosen for solo builder velocity.

nodes.label: Render Worker Service (Node.js)
nodes.rationale: Always-on service using sharp for image compositing (crop, LUT/color-grade, caption overlay) and ffmpeg for Story multi-image crossfade. Lightweight because Post/Carousel/Story are image/short-slideshow, not beat-synced video.

nodes.label: Theme Intelligence Engine
nodes.rationale: Mines Pinterest for best on-theme photography to build reference embedding + compositional profile; drives smarter photo selection. One-time offline Phase A harvest (Apify + Pinterest) → Phase C production corpus from open/licensed APIs (Unsplash, Pexels, etc).

nodes.label: Theme Fingerprint (Embeddings + Metadata)
nodes.rationale: Stores per-theme: centroid_vec (pgvector 1024-dim), palette (LUT), composition_template (target category-mix distribution), notes. Used by live generation pipeline for theme-fit scoring and LUT application.

nodes.label: Content Composition Engine (Slot-Fill)
nodes.rationale: Mood-based selection not filter. Given output length + theme composition_template, allocate slots proportionally across categories, fill each with trip's best theme_fit-scored photo in that category, apply special-slot rules like candid/funny closer, gracefully redistribute when pool missing category.

nodes.label: Content Taxonomy (6 Categories)
nodes.rationale: Fixed set: solo_portrait, group, scenery, food, action_fit, candid_funny. Kept deliberately small so classification stays cheap, slot-fill logic stays simple, classification accuracy stays high.

nodes.label: Trip (Data Entity)
nodes.rationale: Core container: name, slug, owner_id, optional dates/destination. Owner has RLS access; contributors upload via session_token (no auth.users row). Realtime enabled filtered by trip_id.

nodes.label: MediaItem (Data Entity)
nodes.rationale: type (photo/video), storage_path, quality_score (Haiku), content_category (Haiku), theme_fit_scores (jsonb from pgvector cosine), is_favourite. Scored once, used by all themes. Realtime changes update pool.

nodes.label: Generation (Data Entity)
nodes.rationale: type (post/carousel/story), theme_id, status, selection (EDL-lite), output_url, caption, caption_mode, seed. Realtime filtered by trip_id drives generating→reveal transition.

nodes.label: Live Media Pool (Real-time)
nodes.rationale: Organizer sees real-time grid of all contributors' media via Postgres Changes/Realtime. Filters: All/Photos/Videos/Favourites. Live indicator shows active uploads. 'Feels alive' demo centerpiece.

nodes.label: AI Generation Pipeline (Post/Carousel/Story)
nodes.rationale: Days 4-6: naive top-N by quality_score. Days 7-9: slot-fill composition (theme-aware category mix), theme-fit scoring (pgvector cosine similarity), LUT application. Includes captions. ~2-min target end-to-end.

nodes.label: Appless Contribution Flow
nodes.rationale: Organizer shares QR or scenr.app/join/slug link. Contributor opens in mobile browser, tap-to-choose/drag-drop photos+videos, optional name. No account; presigned direct-to-storage upload; pool updates Live. Session token for attribution.

nodes.label: Captions System (3 Modes)
nodes.rationale: Write your own (free-text editor), Generate from content (VLM reads media + trip metadata, drafts caption with hashtags), Theme preset (template with auto-filled slots). Always editable before export.

nodes.label: Free vs Premium Tier System
nodes.rationale: Free: capped uploads/trip + 2 trips/month. Premium ($12.99/mo or $99.99/yr): unlimited, no watermark, all 15 themes, full theme-fit. Server-authoritative enforcement; client displays quota.

nodes.label: API Gateway / BFF (Kong + GraphQL)
nodes.rationale: Stateless edge: TLS termination, routing, JWT validation, rate limiting, quota pre-checks, presigned upload brokering, GraphQL schema stitching, response caching. Owns no domain data. Scales horizontally behind LB.

nodes.label: Auth & User Service (JWT/OAuth)
nodes.rationale: Source of truth for identity, accounts, sessions, JWKS, plan flags. Stateless, always-on, cheap-to-scale tier.

nodes.label: Media Ingestion (Upload Brokering)
nodes.rationale: Presigned direct-to-storage uploads, type/size validation, malware/NSFW scanning, resumable chunking. Media bypasses gateway entirely. Appless and in-app uploaders check quota before accepting.

nodes.label: Postgres (Relational Core)
nodes.rationale: Source of truth for users, trips, media metadata, quotas, generations. Part of Supabase managed platform. RLS scopes access by trip owner.

nodes.label: pgvector (Theme Fingerprint Store)
nodes.rationale: Stores theme centroid vectors (1024-dim multimodal embeddings from Voyage API). Live generation queries via cosine similarity for theme-fit scoring. Part of Supabase Postgres.

nodes.label: Object Storage (S3/GCS)
nodes.rationale: Holds raw uploads and rendered outputs. Supabase Storage bucket with RLS or presigned URLs. Media never flows through API gateway.

nodes.label: Claude Haiku (Vision/Scoring)
nodes.rationale: Cheap per-photo scoring: quality_score and content_category tagging. Same pass used by all themes, no extra API calls. Also used by theme loader to tag harvested Pinterest pins.

nodes.label: Claude Sonnet (Caption Generation)
nodes.rationale: Generates captions from selected media + trip metadata. VLM reads content, drafts on-brand caption with optional hashtags and emoji. Filtered for profanity/brand safety.

nodes.label: Voyage Multimodal Embeddings API
nodes.rationale: Hosted embeddings for theme matching. Used identically by offline theme-loader script and live generation pipeline so cosine similarity is meaningful. voyage-multimodal-3 or similar.

nodes.label: Apify Pinterest Search-Scraper (Phase A)
nodes.rationale: One-time offline research burst (started Day 1, longest-pole dependency). Harvest ~4-5 themes × ~60-80 pins per theme. Quality gate locally, feature extraction, delete source images, keep derived features only.
